args.body: Hi Eve! I visited your blog. It's clean and easy to read, and I like that your passion for hiking comes through right away. To improve it, you could add more content such as trail stories, photos, and route tips, plus some navigation to help readers explore. Nice work!

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's simple, and it's easy to find your contact email. To improve it, you could add more about yourself, such as your background, projects, and interests. A bit of structure and navigation would also make it feel more polished. Nice start!

final_text:
